LESSON: SELF-AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Self-awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Self-awareness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are you a special creation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,
2. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God,
3. acknowledge God as the creator,
4. appreciate his or her uniqueness as God’s special creation. The learner is guided to: 139:13 about being fearfully and wonderfully made, ‘created in the image and likeness of God’ uniqueness. Why are you a special creation? 1

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. acknowledge God as the creator,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acknowledge God as the creator,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate his or her uniqueness as God’s special creation. The learner is guided to: 139:13 about being fearfully and wonderfully made, ‘created in the image and likeness of God’ uniqueness. Why are you a special creation? 1
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate his or her uniqueness as God’s special creation. The learner is guided to: 139:13 about being fearfully and wonderfully made, ‘created in the image and likeness of God’ uniqueness. Why are you a special creation? 1. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Self-awareness.
2. Explain Self-awareness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self-awareness.
4. Show that you can: mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self-awareness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why are you a special creation?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention his or her name for identification and self- awareness,
2. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God,
3. acknowledge God as the creator,
4. appreciate his or her uniqueness as God’s special creation. The learner is guided to: 139:13 about being fearfully and wonderfully made, ‘created in the image and likeness of God’ uniqueness. Why are you a special creation? 1

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
